work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter LXVI (printed EPISTOLA; address LF12107–12109) names Archbishop Jean-Baptiste Auvergne, vicar apostolic of Aleppo, visitor of the Chaldean patriarchate; LF12151 → LF12160 across own provenance LF12154 (Ex Iure Pontificio de P. F.) and page-82 running title LF12157; LF12221 → LF12230 across a tiny mark LF12224 and page number 83 LF12227; complete 25 September 1835 closing. A second printing of this letter in the same volume (XXIV, LF4207) is held by lane b01; the coordinator should reconcile the two witnesses before any work-level join. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF12112–12112; the source closing at LF12230–12233 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima quinta septembris millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo quinto, pontificatus Nostri anno quinto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
